---
name: Frontend Quality
description: "Use when implementing or reviewing frontend UI, styling, components, client state, responsive layouts, or visual assets."
applyTo: ["**/*.tsx","**/*.jsx","**/*.vue","**/*.svelte","**/*.css","**/*.scss"]
---
# Frontend Quality

- Preserve semantic HTML, keyboard access, visible focus, contrast, and screen-reader meaning.
- Define loading, empty, error, permission, and degraded states.
- Keep view rendering separate from data fetching and domain logic.
- Respect responsive layouts, reduced motion, performance budgets, and design tokens.
- Validate user-visible behavior with focused tests or reproducible evidence.
